messages:
tess: Heads-up: new hire onboarding hit a blocker following the Python SDK quickstart. `pip install -e .` fails on macOS arm with an import error from async client.

pranav: Can you paste the error?

tess: ```
$ pip install -e .
Obtaining file:///workspace/redwood-python-sdk
Installing collected packages: typing-extensions, ...
ERROR: Cannot import name 'TypeAlias' from 'typing_extensions' (/opt/homebrew/.../typing_extensions/__init__.py)
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "redwood/client/async_client.py", line 14, in <module>
    from typing_extensions import TypeAlias
ImportError: cannot import name 'TypeAlias' from 'typing_extensions'
```

kai: What Python and typing-extensions versions?

tess: Python 3.10.6, pip 23.1, typing-extensions==4.0.1 per `pip freeze`. Strange: CI x86 passes, mac arm fails.

pranav: Likely a transitive resolution picking an older typing-extensions on arm. Quick fixes: 1) pin `typing-extensions` in pyproject.toml to a version that includes TypeAlias (>=4.6), 2) add a safe import fallback in code while we release.

kai: For (2) use this pattern in `async_client.py`:
```
try:
    from typing_extensions import TypeAlias
except Exception:
    from typing import Any as TypeAlias  # runtime fallback for older deps
```
Add a TODO to remove once deps are pinned.

pranav: Also add a CI job that runs `pip install -e .` on macos-13 in a clean runner and executes `python -c "import redwood.client.async_client"`. That'll catch editable/PEP660 issues in the matrix.

tess: I'll open a PR that pins `typing-extensions = ">=4.6.0,<5"`, adds the macos editable install job, and includes the small import test in the matrix. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-python-sdk/pull/1301 (WIP).

devx-bot: New issue created: #502 - macOS arm editable install fails due to typing-extensions TypeAlias import.

kai: Also update CONTRIBUTING.md with a note about editable installs and PEP 660 compatibility. Some engineers forget the difference between `pip install .` and `pip install -e .` which affects wheels vs editable metadata.

pranav: Good catch. When we release, add a short changelog entry advising integrators to upgrade typing-extensions if they use older pinned lockfiles.

tess: Will do. Thanks — will ping when PR is ready for review. :thumbsup:
